data.whatItDoes: Marc Anthony Strictly Curls 3X Moisture Triple Blend Conditioner 250ml hydrates and detangles curly hair, reducing frizz for soft, defined curls.
pros: Infused with marula oil, coconut cream and shea butter, it restores moisture, strengthens hair and protects against environmental stressors.
Strictly Curls 3X Moisture is formulated with a triple blend of marula oil, coconut and shea butter.
It gives thirsty curls the essential moisture they need to feel strengthened, smoothed and protected.
It all adds up to hair that’s always soft, frizz-free and ready for play.

specifications.name: How to use
specifications.value: Apply to wet hair after shampooing, massage and rinse. For best results, use with Strictly Curls 3X Moisture Shampoo.

specifications.name: Storage instructions
specifications.value: Store in a cool, dry place.

specifications.name: Warnings
specifications.value: For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately
